static_traits.name: 周婷
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友和家人的关系因其对体重的过度关注而紧张；有一位亲密朋友但尚not yet分享自己的身心困扰
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前not yet有类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗/咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能Reflection自身感受，情绪以Anxiety为主，配合度高，态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我因担心自己会永远超重而感到overwhelmed，尽管只减了5磅；过去几个月里这一直引发持续的压力与Anxiety，尤其在餐后、照镜子或称体重时更明显。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative thoughts about weight and appearance have already affected mental health and daily function; I hope to learn to manage these thoughts through counseling, so as to feel better.
growth_experiences: 几个月前开始新的节食计划后，因他人关于体重的评论而trigger对身材的高压关注；随着时间推移Anxiety worsened，出现每日多次称重、在餐后与照镜子时反复Self-denial，并逐渐回避与食物相关的社交，饮食模式变得紊乱。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于体重和外貌
如果短期内看not到显著结果，就说明我做not到、也not会改变

special_situations.event: 称体重看到数字变化not明显或仅有小幅下降
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果体重have not快速明显下降，就说明减重without望、我会一直很胖
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁称重以寻求确定感并加强控制
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我只减了5磅，我会永远很胖。

special_situations.event: 餐后或照镜子时关注身材外形
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I see any 'flaw', it proves I have failed at losing weight
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding food-related social occasions, tightening diet to avoid 'making mistakes'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我看起来很糟，这说明我失败了。

special_situations.event: 回想起他人对自己体重的评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人评论我的体重，就说明我not被接受、他们在negate我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not向朋友倾诉、Reduced socializing接触以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得我很胖、很not自律。

special_situations.event: 意识到自己仅减重约5磅
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有显著、快速的体重下降才算成功，其他都not值得肯定
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate已有进步、加大自我要求与控制

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized, hoping to gain a sense of value and security by controlling the body and appearance
core_conflict.fear: Fears being evaluated, humiliated, and rejected; worries about losing control and being seen as a failure
defense_goal: 以自我批评和高标准来预防Being rejected或羞耻
通过Avoids socializing与not披露脆弱感来保持安全距离
用对体重数字的控制感来缓解内在not安

object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者/挑剔的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当面对或Anticipation他人对其体重/外貌的评论（如聚餐、与人见面）
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会像评审一样挑剔并拒绝我（移情性地将内在苛责Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use模糊与回避的表述、减少自我暴露，语气谨慎，Displacement到“最近很忙/not太饿”等中性话题。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others affirm positive changes such as losing 5 pounds
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 这些正向信息并not可靠或“have not意义”，需要用更严格标准来衡量
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用数字与规则强调“not算真正的进步”，语气平淡、避免谈情绪体验，以数据反驳正向反馈。

manifestations: 因羞耻感not yet向亲密朋友分享困扰
回避与食物相关的社交活动，Relationship tension与疏远
在体重问题上感到被困与孤立
outcomes: Insufficient use of social support，情感支持缺失

manifestations: Dominated by weight numbers and external evaluations; the space for inner choice and experience is compressed
Constrains himself with the value condition 'must be thin to count as good'
Pursues a sense of control through frequent weighing and strict diet control
outcomes: 强迫式监控（多次称重）与饮食紊乱

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Using body weight numbers and others' evaluations as the core standard of self-worth
negate“减重5磅”等积极变化，认为“not算成功”
Insisting on the rule that 'one must be thin to be good / to be worth accepting'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 自责“如果连减重都做not到，其他方面也会失败”
担心“给朋友添麻烦”而not求助，过度克制自我表达
Cautious when interacting with people, avoids exposing vulnerability and shame

positive_force: Help-seeking motivation is clear, attitude is positive, willing to try cognitive restructuring (de-catastrophizing)
Able to persist with certain diet and exercise attempts, has achieved about 5 pounds of objective progress
Has potential social support resources (has a close friend he is willing to trust)
能觉察trigger情境（餐后、照镜子、称重）并表达内心体验
negative_force: 灾难化、非黑即白、过度概括与negate积极的认知偏差显著
Tightly binding self-worth to weight and appearance, forming a rigid standard
A problem-maintaining behavior cycle of weighing multiple times daily, avoiding food-related socializing, etc.
Shame and high sensitivity to others' evaluations reduce access to help and support
对短期结果的过高期待导致挫败与without助感

target_behavior.behavior: 每日多次称重与体重监控
antecedent: 对体重与外貌的Anxiety升高时
target_behavior.core_reason: 通过监控数字获得控制感与确定感，以缓解灾难化Anticipation（“如果not降就永远胖”）
target_behavior.function: 短期缓解Anxiety、获取暂时的确定感与安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Reinforcement对数字的依赖与Anxiety循环，情绪受挫并加重Self-denial，影响日常生活

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与食物相关的社交活动
antecedent: 想到可能在聚会被他人评价身材
接到含有聚餐元素的社交邀请
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被评价与羞耻，将内在苛责Projection到他人目光中
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and uncomfortable emotions
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships疏远与Increased sense of isolation，获得社会支持的机会减少

target_behavior.behavior: 饮食模式紊乱（在not同饮食/运动方案之间频繁切换）
target_behavior.core_reason: Black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization lead to catastrophizing interpretations of short-term fluctuations, eager to regain control through new plans
target_behavior.function: 寻求快速有效的控制感与“成功感”
target_behavior.consequence: 难以形成稳定健康的饮食习惯，进一步加剧挫败与Anxiety
